title: Natural-error yardstick for critics (v1)
description: 95 answers by llama3.1:8b to in-domain questions, each labelled for factual, numeric and reasoning errors by two blind Claude passes (Opus, Sonnet) and adjudicated: 59 with an error, 36 clean, 84 error sentences marked by both. Includes 31 correction pairs (the original answer, and a copy with its agreed errors rewritten), and the flags of five local screen judges. Labels are model-made, not human-verified. In the v1 screens a failed reply is stored as an empty list: muse-glimmer had 1 such reply, nemotron-3.5-lightning 39 (its v1 run is unreliable; a context-rich re-screen with failure reasons will replace these). See README.md.
